summary: Vellacombe chemistry readout (13 February 1997) to Elvarmere Biosciences AB for VD-96-072: route A to the pyrrolopyridine series, separation of the N-alkylation regioisomers by preparative chromatography, and delivery of 24 analogues for Elvarmere's first potency screen.

slides.title: Objectives
bullets: Establish a route to the EB05 pyrrolopyridine core
Deliver 24 analogues for the first potency screen

slides.title: Route A
bullets: Core built in four steps from the aminopyridine
Isolated, not just proposed: all structures on the following slides were made

slides.title: Regioisomer separation
bullets: Flash chromatography failed to resolve the pair
Preparative HPLC (reverse phase) gave baseline separation
Route risk: throughput limited to about 2 g per week
slides.notes: Elvarmere asked whether a selective alkylation is possible - route scout B in the next phase.

rows: Full compound cards for all 24 analogues are in the delivery lot paperwork
Isolated yields are for the final step
Purity by LCMS area percent at 254 nm

slides.title: Conclusions
bullets: Route A works but separation is the bottleneck
All 24 analogues delivered in two delivery lots
Desired regioisomer secured for the potency screen

slides.title: Next analogue
bullets: Second analogue set once potency data are back
Dr R. Calderwood, Vellacombe Discovery Ltd
